quote: Noise is the most impertinent of all forms of interruption. It is not only an interruption, but also a disruption of thought.
source: Arthur Schopenhauer, Parerga and Paralipomena, ‘On Noise’, in Studies in Pessimism (trans. T. Bailey Saunders, 1890)
